title: Router selection
help: Enter the UPnP XML device description URL, not the router's sign-in page. The router must allow UPnP access from this network.
layers: For nested NAT, configure each router separately: on the public router, forward to the next router's WAN address; on the inner router, forward to the service's LAN address.
public: Public IPv4 reported; inbound access still needs an external test.
private: Private WAN address: another NAT layer remains upstream.
shared: Shared WAN address: an upstream NAT remains; operator support may be required.
unknown: A public IPv4 address could not be confirmed.
failed: Could not check the selected router
empty: No routers were discovered. You can enter an upstream device description URL manually.
enumerationUnavailable: This router does not support listing mappings. You can still add a mapping; check its admin page to inspect or remove existing rules.
incomplete: The router returned an incomplete mapping list. Open its admin page to inspect all rules.
